_comment: W2 quality gates. axe-core is injected by the studio's Playwright into an isolated world of the preview page only (core/aas_build/qa.py); it is never copied into a generated app or a served file. qa.py refuses to run when the file's sha256 differs from this manifest. Refresh deliberately: download the npm tarball, check its sha512 integrity against the registry, extract package/axe.min.js, record the new hashes.
